stem:
A particle starts with an acceleration ‘α’ immediately followed with a deceleration ‘β’ and finally coming to stop. The total time duration of motion is ‘T’ then find:
(i) The time of acceleration (in terms of T)
(ii) The maximum speed reached:
(iii) The total distance travelled:
(iv) Average speed for the entire duration of motion:

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph: rising with slope α to v_max at t₁, then falling with slope −β to zero at T. Below the axis, t₁ = v_max/α and t₂ = v_max/β.
